name: Ouroboros Energy Radiant Null Beacon
description:
The Radiant Null Beacon operates on a principle of controlled electromagnetic contradiction — it broadcasts a precisely tuned counter-signal across seventeen frequency bands simultaneously, creating a localized zone of communicative silence that reads to external scanners not as jamming but as natural dead air. At its core is a micro-fusion cell borrowed from Ouroboros Energy's industrial power regulation line, repurposed to sustain the counter-broadcast for up to seventy-two hours without recharge. The device is roughly the size of a flattened grenade and is typically magnetic-mounted to structural surfaces or dropped into ventilation systems.

What distinguishes the Null Beacon from conventional jammers is its 'ghost signature' emulation layer — rather than creating a detectable wall of interference, it mimics the electromagnetic profile of an inactive urban node, making it nearly invisible to passive sweeps. This was originally developed for Ouroboros's pipeline survey teams operating in contested territories, where communications blackouts needed to appear organic rather than tactical. The result is a device that is terrifyingly effective at concealing coordinated action under the cover of apparent silence.

The Null Beacon has become a fixture in the toolkit of extraction teams, political dissidents, and anyone who needs a meeting to stay off the record. Corporate security divisions have developed specific counter-protocols for detecting them, but the cat-and-mouse cycle of firmware updates keeps the Beacon one step ahead in most civilian environments. Owning one without licensing paperwork is a prosecutable offense in six of GLMZ's administrative districts.

specifications.activation_method: Proximity trigger, manual toggle, or remote detonation fob
specifications.detection_resistance: Rated against Tier 1–3 passive sweep systems
specifications.mounting: Integrated neodymium magnetic base, optional adhesive saddle

tactical_use: Deployed prior to sensitive meetings, extractions, or ambushes where comm silence is required without alerting surveillance infrastructure. Teams typically place multiple units to overlap suppression radii, ensuring no gaps. The device's ghost signature makes it preferable to conventional jammers when stealth is paramount — a hard jam announces itself; a Null Beacon simply makes a neighborhood go quiet.
cultural_context: In GLMZ's lower districts, possession of a Null Beacon is an unspoken signal of serious intent. Street-level fixers who carry them are understood to operate in spaces where corporate oversight cannot follow. Among mid-tier corporate employees, they're a nervous status symbol — proof that someone has meetings worth hiding. Ouroboros Energy officially sells them only to licensed survey and infrastructure contractors, but the gray market is flooded with units that have had their serial burns chemically stripped.
story_hooks: A Null Beacon activates in a residential block with no obvious source — someone is having a meeting that half of GLMZ's factions want to know about.
A licensed Null Beacon is found at a murder scene, its serial traced back to an Ouroboros Energy survey team that officially disbanded three years ago.
The players are hired to retrieve a Beacon that contains a ghost-signature profile so sophisticated it can fool Tier 5 corporate sweep systems — something that should not exist in a consumer device.
A dissident group has been using Null Beacons to coordinate across the city, but someone is slowly updating the counter-protocols to expose them — and they want to know who.

physical_description.visual_profile: A flattened, oblate ovoid resembling a compressed grenade or thick hockey puck. The device has an organic, almost biological quality to its form — not angular or aggressive, but deliberately unassuming. Its surface is deliberately bland to avoid attention, with no dramatic vents or warning indicators. The top hemisphere is slightly domed, the bottom features a prominent magnetic base ring.
physical_description.dimensions: 11cm x 7cm x 4cm; roughly the size of a small paperback book stood on edge, or a military-grade hockey puck
physical_description.weight_description: 340g — handheld but substantial, dense enough to feel purposeful. Easily pocketable in cargo gear or a utility bag, pocketable in a heavy coat. Magnetic mount means it clings to metal rather than requiring straps.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed titanium-composite housing with internal micro-fusion cell shielding. The casing appears matte and industrial, not polished.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal-grey with microscopic texturing that defeats fingerprint visibility and reduces light reflection. Deliberately non-reflective to avoid scanner glints. Subtle radial scoring patterns suggest heat-dissipation channels.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominantly charcoal-grey with accent bands of muted teal (frequency indicator stripe) and faint phosphorescent green edge-trim (activation state indicator visible only in darkness). Minimalist branding in industrial sans-serif.
physical_description.interface_elements: Top surface features a single flush recessed button (manual activation toggle), a tiny teal LED status window (triangular, 8mm), and a maintenance port hidden under a magnetic cover. Magnetic base ring doubles as charging contact. Optional rubber saddle mount points flank the sides. No screen, no feedback — intentionally silent.
distinctive_features: Magnetic base ring with interlocking ferrite core visible as a dark circle
Radial cooling channels etched across the dome as functional art
Teal frequency-lock indicator stripe wrapping the equator
Phosphorescent green edge highlights that glow subtly under blacklight (activation status)
Nearly invisible Infinite Loop Recycling mark — just a tiny circular Ouroboros symbol stamped on one edge in matching grey
Micro-fusion cell visible as a slightly raised golden-bronze disc beneath the dome (backlit through thin composite)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Infinite Loop Recycling circular Ouroboros logo (snake eating its tail) stamped subtly on lower edge. Micro-fusion tech derived from Ouroboros Energy branding on the magnetic base ring in laser-etched lettering. Serial number laser-marked on base. No regulatory stamps visible (intentional design).
physical_description.condition_typical: In field use, typically shows dust accumulation in the radial grooves, faint magnetic residue smudges on the base ring from multiple mounting/unmounting cycles, and occasional small dents from impact or pressure. When active, the teal frequency indicator flickers in a specific pattern (one pulse per 3 seconds) visible only to those who know to look.
